fixture.declaredMethod: Union of 3 areas in EPSG:32630. The parts cover 847861 m² between them and 659511 m² once combined. 188351 m² was covered more than once. Combining answers whether anywhere is covered, not how well. Two areas overlapping meant two things reached the same ground, and that is now gone. What distinguished the parts — which facility, which site — is discarded. That is the operation, not a defect.

criterion: the combined geometry within 1 m2 by symmetric difference, the combined area and the summed parts area each within 1 m2, and the part and piece counts unchanged
notEstablished: That the combined area means what a reader will take it to mean. It is distinct ground covered by at least one corridor: not a population, not a catchment, not a service area.
